icd_linked.llm_icd_reason: Mapped ICD at matched rank 1 is N20.0 (Calculus of kidney), whereas the billed primary code is N13.2 (Hydronephrosis with renal and ureteral calculous obstruction). N13.2 requires documented obstructive hydronephrosis in addition to the calculus and is a combination code sequenced as principal; a coder would not accept plain N20.0 as equivalent. (Note: rank 3 carried the exact N13.2 code, but the lowest matching rank per the rules is rank 1.)
